sections.text:
Before isolated the diesel 
 engine mechanically and electrically

The engine must be operated 
 and check the following steps and reads all the available record values and 
 putted in operation & maintenance record data sheet (MRDS) Table (1).

rows:
Check the 
 compression pressures in the individual cylinders

Check the 
 uniform power distribution on cylinders

Check any 
 leakage from the piping connections to the diesel engine or its accessories 
 (water, lube oil, fuel, and air).

Check (by 
 listening) the regular operation of the engine and whether there is no 
 abnormal sounds or knocks

Check whether 
 there are no heavy knocks in the injection valve pipe.

Check the 
 operation of suction and exhaust valves, check the condition of the valve 
 springs

Check (by 
 touch) the crankshaft and camshaft bearings temperature rise on the case 
 covers of the cylinder blocks, at the points where the bearings are located

sections.text:
After isolated the diesel engine 
mechanically and electrically

items:
Check the oil level in the tank and / or refill it from the storage tank up to 
 the top mark on the level gauge.

Turn the handles 
 of the coarse (lamination type) oil cleaner fitted in the oil circuit.

Check 
 the clogging of the fine oil cleaners acc.to the differential pressure gauges 
 data.

Check 
 the amount of leakage from stuffing box of fuel pump and prevented it by 
 retighten the gland bolts or replace the sealing ring { it must be dropped some drops to cool the 
 gland}.

Check 
 the temperature of the crankshaft bearings by touching the side lids of the 
 upper engine case, thus the safety of operation is increased.
 . 
 At 
 higher temperature it is necessary to dismantle the lids and to check the 
 condition of bearing cca 10 min after engine stopping.

sections.text:
Check whether the suction and 
 exhaust valve clearance are correct by means of gauges.

Check the clearance between the 
 valve and the rocker arms roller with the 
 responding cam in its basic position

items:
Check the clearance between the 
 valve and the rocker arms roller with the 
 responding cam in its basic position
Adjust the clearance if necessary.

Check whether the 
 clearance is sufficient by checking with cam in their basis position, whether the valves push 
 rods can be turned

sections.text:
Check the fuel injection pump, check 
 particularly the pump plunger wear.

Uncouple the fuel injection pump 
 from the fuel injection valves and close it tightly (Is recommended to use a 
 plug screw for this propose).

Take out the pump by hand by 
 means of the lever supplied with the engine tools.

Fit the lever into the hole in the 
 tappet guide body above the fuel injection pump tappet.

If there is a hard 
 resistance, it is a sign that the piston clearance is correct.

items:
Uncouple the fuel injection pump 
 from the fuel injection valves and close it tightly (Is recommended to use a 
 plug screw for this propose).

Take out the pump by hand by 
 means of the lever supplied with the engine tools.

Fit the lever into the hole in the 
 tappet guide body above the fuel injection pump tappet.

If there is a hard 
 resistance, it is a sign that the piston clearance is correct.

If there is a soft resistance, (with 
 the lever slowly dropping), it is a sign that the piston clearance is large 
 and piston must be replaced.

Check the nuts tightening of 
 injection cams (See major maintenance procedure)

Clean and flush with fuel the 
 suction strainer in the oil tank.

Check the flow of water through the 
 engine, be sure that there is no clogging by impurities, throttling or 
 clogging with scales on the water transfer pipe and remove the scales if found 
 (See major maintenance procedure).

Clean the air distributor and smear 
 it with grease.

Check the fuel injection valves or 
 removal of the valves from the cylinder head (by means of a nozzle tester)

Check the setting of the opening 
 pressure.

Check the fuel is sprayed by the 
 valve through all holes and clean these holes if it is clogged by means of the 
 nozzle cleaner.

Check the function and the 
 reliability of the signaling equipment. When checking and adjust the signaling 
 equipment, it is absolutely necessary to check continuously the operating 
 conditions of the engine specially the oil pressure.

Keep the surface of the engine 
 clean.
